about.label: WHO I AM
about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I am a Computer Engineering graduate with hands-on experience in FPGA design, digital systems, software development, networking, Linux, and cybersecurity. I enjoy building reliable solutions across hardware and software, with a strong interest in design verification, embedded systems, and infrastructure technologies.

My experience includes Verilog and SystemVerilog, FPGA development, simulation and verification, full-stack development, Windows Server, virtualization, networking, and security labs. projects.title: FPGA-Based Cryptographic System
projects.purpose: AES-128 CTR encryption and SHA-256 hashing implemented in SystemVerilog and deployed on a DE10-Standard Cyclone V FPGA.
projects.overview: A graduation project covering the design, simulation, optimization, and FPGA implementation of dedicated cryptographic hardware modules.
projects.problem: Software-only cryptography can add processing latency and CPU workload. This project explored FPGA acceleration while preserving correct, verifiable behavior.
projects.implementation: Dedicated RTL modules cover AES round processing, key expansion, counter-mode control, SHA-256 message padding, streaming data handling, finite-state-machine control, and verification testbenches.
projects.role: FPGA Hardware Designer and Verification Developer
responsibilities: Designed the AES-128 CTR architecture, AES round module, key expansion, control FSM, and top-level FPGA integration.
Designed the SHA-256 processing core and message-padding logic.
Created self-checking simulation testbenches and debugged timing and control-flow behavior with waveforms.
Integrated and physically validated the cryptographic modules on the DE10-Standard Cyclone V board.
challenges: Reducing processing cycles without breaking the AES algorithm or key schedule.
Synchronizing input-ready, output-ready, busy, and done control signals.
Implementing correct SHA-256 message padding and big-endian length encoding.
Debugging simulation timing and checking outputs at safe clock edges.
Adapting the design after an earlier version exceeded the resources of a smaller Cyclone IV FPGA.
keyResults: Implemented AES-128 CTR encryption and SHA-256 hashing in hardware.
Reduced AES processing from 36 to 27 clock cycles per block.
Observed an AES block-processing time of approximately 480 ns.
Verified RTL modules with self-checking simulation testbenches.
Deployed and tested the final design on a Cyclone V FPGA board.

projects.title: QudsCare
projects.purpose: A cross-platform educational healthcare application developed for nursing, anesthesia, and pharmacy students at Al-Quds University, providing organized medication information and interactive learning resources.
projects.overview: QudsCare is an educational healthcare application designed for nursing, anesthesia, and pharmacy students at Al-Quds University. The application helps students access organized medication information, explore healthcare topics by specialization, and review essential academic content through a mobile-friendly and user-friendly interface.
projects.problem: Healthcare students often need to search through multiple books, documents, and online sources to find medication information relevant to their specialization. This makes studying slower and can make it difficult to quickly locate organized and relevant educational content.
projects.solution: QudsCare provides a centralized educational platform that organizes medications and healthcare information into specialized nursing, anesthesia, and pharmacy modules. It includes searchable medication content, structured clinical information, and offline access through a cross-platform application available for Android and the web.

projects.title: SOOQNA – E-Commerce Marketplace
projects.purpose: A full-stack multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace connecting customers and merchants, with support for credit cards, PayPal, cryptocurrency payments, and invoice generation.
projects.overview: SOOQNA is a university software project developed as a multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace. The platform allows merchants to list and manage products while customers can browse products, place orders, complete payments through multiple payment methods, and receive invoices.
projects.problem: Traditional e-commerce platforms may support only limited payment methods and often focus on a single seller. The project aimed to create a marketplace where multiple merchants could offer their products while customers could choose between conventional and cryptocurrency-based payment options.
projects.solution: A full-stack marketplace was developed using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and a locally hosted MongoDB database. The platform provides separate customer and merchant workflows, product and order management, multiple payment integrations, and invoice generation.

projects.title: TMS – Trip Management System
projects.purpose: A production trip-management platform for organizing travel packages, supplier coordination, quotations, and collaborative planning.
projects.overview: TMS is a real-world business application used by a travel and tourism company to manage the complete lifecycle of organized trips. It centralizes flight itineraries, hotels, transportation, transfers, tour guides, suppliers, and quotation preparation within one collaborative system.
projects.problem: Preparing a complete travel package requires coordinating flights, hotels, transportation, transfers, guides, and multiple service providers. Separate spreadsheets, messages, and emails make collaboration difficult and increase the possibility of missing or inconsistent information.
projects.solution: TMS provides a centralized workflow where authorized employees can create and manage complete travel itineraries, organize the required services, prepare structured quotations, and send requests to multiple suppliers from one system.

challenges: Organizing many interconnected travel services within one clear workflow.
Supporting collaboration between multiple employees.
Managing quotations composed of several services and suppliers.
Coordinating communication with multiple companies efficiently.
Protecting private company, customer, supplier, and quotation information.
keyResults: Delivered a real production system for a travel and tourism company.
Centralized trip planning, service coordination, and quotation preparation.

Reduced dependence on separate spreadsheets, messages, and manual workflows.

projects.title: PMS – Project Management System
projects.purpose: A Java desktop project-management system connected to an Oracle database, featuring role-based access for administrators and employees, task assignment, project tracking, secure password hashing, and dynamic data search.
projects.overview: PMS is a desktop project-management application designed to help an administrator manage projects, employees, users, and tasks through one centralized system. Employees access a separate dashboard where they can view the tasks assigned specifically to them.
projects.problem: Managing projects and employee tasks manually makes it difficult to track responsibilities, deadlines, progress, and task status. Employees also need a clear way to access only the tasks assigned to them, while administrators require complete control over users, projects, employees, and assignments.
projects.solution: A Java desktop application was developed and connected to an Oracle database. The system uses one authentication screen for all users, identifies the account type, and redirects administrators and employees to their appropriate dashboards. The administrator can manage system records and assign tasks, while employees can access their own assigned work.
